info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Deletion API
info.description: The Customer Deletion API allows businesses to manage customer records by enabling the removal of specific customer data using their unique identifier. This operation is crucial for maintaining an up-to-date database, helping organizations comply with data privacy regulations and improve data accuracy. Typical consumers include system administrators and data privacy officers who require tools to efficiently delete customer records. The API streamlines compliance and enhances data management practices across various applications.

delete.description: This operation removes the specified customer, identified by their unique ID, from the system. Ensure that this action is intended, as it cannot be undone.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details required for deleting the customer identified by CUST-100045. Ensure that all necessary parameters comply with the API's requirements to successfully execute the delete operation.

204.description: The customer resource has been successfully deleted.

DeleteCustomerCUST100045Request.description: Request body for the DELETE operation of customer CUST-100045. This string represents the payload that may be sent with the request.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a Bearer token for authentication, leveraging JSON Web Tokens (JWT) for secure transmission of user identity and claims. Clients must include the bearer token in the 'Authorization' header of their requests.
